labels.labeler_note: 'Japanese cuisine' is a stretch proxy for 'yêu thích Nhật Bản nói chung' (food interest != language-learning intent), but it's the only Japan-specific interest in the 71-item catalog (no anime/culture/Japan-general segment exists — verified) so it's kept rather than dropped. Promoted 'Travel' into must_include as a second, broader Japan-affinity proxy. Downgraded 'Digital Activities' out of must_include (too broad for grade-2, per the same reasoning as brief_007) and moved it to acceptable. must_exclude=Real estate kept as a weak generic high-consideration-purchase mismatch.
